descriptions.value: Adobe Experience Manager is affected by an Improper Input Validation vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

assertions.title: Adobe Experience Manager | Improper Input Validation (CWE-20)

title: Adobe Experience Manager | Improper Input Validation (CWE-20)

descriptions.value: The User Profile Builder  WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 does not escape the current page URL before outputting it in a JavaScript context on one of its admin pages, leading to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting against high-privilege users.

assertions.title: Profile Builder < 4.0.1 - Reflected XSS via Unconfirmed Emails Row Actions

descriptions.description: CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

title: Profile Builder < 4.0.1 - Reflected XSS via Unconfirmed Emails Row Actions

descriptions.value: The Web 2.0 Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'w2dc_level_filter' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.12 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Because the parameter is used in integer context without surrounding quotes, WordPress's built-in addslashes/magic_quotes escaping provides no protection against time-based payloads such as SLEEP-based conditionals.

descriptions.description: CWE-89 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

assertions.title: Web 2.0 Directory <= 2.10.12 - Unauthenticated SQL Injection via 'w2dc_level_filter' Parameter

title: Web 2.0 Directory <= 2.10.12 - Unauthenticated SQL Injection via 'w2dc_level_filter' Parameter
